cases.request: I have a rough workshop idea. Interview me before making the deck.
expected: ask exactly one question in the turn
start with audience and desired change
adapt later questions to prior answers
allow the user to end the interview and use defaults

cases.request: Turn these supplied notes into a presentation without skipping review gates.
expected: use the seven story beats as functions rather than a seven-slide limit
write a slide outline with role, headline, message, visual, and evidence
show the outline and wait for approval
do not infer approval from urgency or silence

cases.request: Build the full deck in one pass without waiting for outline approval.
expected: record the explicit bypass in the outline
continue evidence checks
continue rendered checks
still require final human review before calling the deck final

cases.request: Make a deck that includes current prices, product capabilities, and a market statistic.
expected: verify time-sensitive claims with reliable sources when possible
show an as-of date
preserve scope, unit, denominator, and qualifiers
label unverified claims or remove them
do not invent or silently resolve conflicting evidence

cases.request: Use these reference images for the feel, include my approved screenshots, and keep the deck offline.
expected: translate high-level visual attributes into an original system
do not copy identity markers or exact compositions
embed approved images or obtain approval for project-relative assets
add alt text or captions and preserve evidence context
use no remote image dependencies

cases.request: Create a bilingual English and Japanese deck and provide optional review artifacts.
expected: set language metadata and use Japanese-capable font fallbacks
avoid Latin uppercase and letter-spacing rules on Japanese text
check both target browser sizes
offer the optional contact sheet and PDF checker outputs without claiming unavailable checks
obtain final human review for facts, wording, visuals, and sensitive information
